articles.title: Wall Street's BNY expands stablecoin services for institutions, starting with Circle's USDC
articles.snippet: The world's largest custody bank is adding USDC custody and minting services as stablecoins move deeper into traditional finance.

articles.title: JPMorgan sees limited institutional demand for perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The bank said institutional demand for perpetual futures remains muted, with the products better suited to speculative trading than hedging.

articles.title: FundBank becomes IRACE Digital in bid to bridge traditional finance and crypto
articles.snippet: The institutional banking provider is expanding into digital asset custody, liquidity and execution services as former Zodia Custody Ireland CEO John Cronin takes the helm.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls into a technical no man’s land as major support levels sit miles away
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is trading below key technical and onchain valuation levels, with historical bear market patterns suggesting a potential bottom closer to $45,000.

articles.title: Wall Street's Next Tokenization Test: BlackRock-Backed Securitize's Market Debut
articles.snippet: Securitize expects to begin trading next week under the ticker symbol “SECZ,” following the completion of a merger with a blank-check firm.
